audio.strategy: Generated buffers only. One piano-like voice is synthesized at runtime by additive synthesis (src/audio/pianoRenderer.ts) into Float32 AudioBuffers per note and velocity layer, played through AudioBufferSourceNode -> per-voice GainNode -> master GainNode -> destination. No recorded samples are bundled or fetched. Nothing is described as a recording.

generatedSources.name: Generated additive piano voice
generatedSources.description: Up to 28 inharmonic partials (f_n = n·f0·sqrt(1+B·n²)) with a hammer-position comb filter, velocity-dependent brightness (partial roll-off exponent), two-stage exponential decay (prompt sound + aftersound), a 2 ms attack ramp and a 9 ms seeded-noise hammer thump. Peak-normalized then scaled by the velocity loudness curve. Deterministic for identical inputs.
generatedSources.rootNotes: every key is rendered at its own pitch (no pitch shifting); buffers are rendered lazily on demand and kept in an LRU cache of 64, with a warm-up bank of C4–C5 rendered right after the audio context starts
generatedSources.bufferLength: up to 4 s (bass) down to about 1.5 s (treble), at the audio context sample rate
generatedSources.license: Original code written for this candidate; no third-party audio material.

generatedSources.name: Fallback triangle tone
generatedSources.description: Only used when the piano renderer throws. A triangle OscillatorNode with a 5 ms attack and 2.5 s exponential decay through the same per-voice gain and master path. The status strip and program display label this state as 'fallback'.
generatedSources.license: Original code written for this candidate.

notes: Web Audio is created lazily on the first key press or the Start audio button; status is reported as idle, loading (warm-up bank rendering), ready, error (no AudioContext available) or fallback (renderer failure).
Sustain (UI pedal button, Shift key, MIDI CC64) is the only panel-independent audio behaviour; every physical panel control is decorative in Phase 1 and changes presentation state only.

Polyphony is capped at 32 voices; the oldest sounding voice is stolen deterministically with a 20 ms release. Note release is a 300 ms exponential ramp; retriggered notes release in 30 ms; all-notes-off uses 80 ms.

Tests never touch real audio output, MIDI devices or the network: the audio context, MIDI access and timers are injected (src/audio/boundaries.ts) and faked in tests (src/audio/fakeAudio.ts); audible relationships are proved on rendered sample data through src/audio/offlineRender.ts.

inputs.pointer: pointerdown/up/cancel with per-pointer tracking, glissando across keys, independent multi-touch, velocity from the strike position on the key
inputs.computerKeyboard: physical key codes A W S E D F T G Y H U J K O L P ; ' = C4..F5 (base shifts with Z/X, clamped to the keybed), Shift = sustain, auto-repeat suppressed, blur/visibility-hidden releases everything
inputs.midi: Web MIDI note on/off with velocity on any channel, CC64 sustain, CC120/123 all notes off; unsupported / requesting / ready / denied / error / disconnected states, disconnect releases the device's notes
